summary: Acrivon Therapeutics filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing that it entered an asset purchase agreement with Aqilion AB, an unlisted Swedish public limited company, to acquire that company's oral JAK1 inhibitor discovery and development programs, including ACR-525 (formerly AQ280), plus a PKC inhibitor preclinical program targeting inflammatory or autoimmune diseases. Consideration was paid entirely in cash with no milestone, royalty, or additional payment obligations; specific price, premium, board recommendation, and advisor were not disclosed. The transaction appears already consummated at signing, so no regulatory or closing clock remains; watch integration execution and pipeline risk.
